preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(i, int) and i >= 1 for i in [n, k, x])
preconditions.description: n, k, and x are positive integers (1 ≤ n, k ≤ 200 000, 1 ≤ x ≤ 10^9).
The array a has exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(ai, int) and abs(ai) <= 10**9 for ai in a)

postconditions.description: The output array b has exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: all(bi % x == ai % x for ai, bi in zip(a, b))
postconditions.description: For each i, b_i ≡ a_i mod x (i.e., b_i = a_i + m_i * x for some integer m_i).

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for ai, bi in zip(a, b) if ai != bi) <= k
postconditions.description: The total number of operations (differences between a and b) is at most k.

postconditions.expression: all(bi == ai + m_i * x for ai, bi in zip(a, b) for m_i in [0, 1, -1, 2, -2, ...] if abs(m_i) <= k)
postconditions.description: Each b_i is reachable from a_i by adding or subtracting x up to k times in total across all elements.

postconditions.expression: product(b) <= product(b') for all possible b' satisfying Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4
postconditions.description: The product of b is the minimum possible among all valid configurations.
